text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Happy birthday to you too, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, a birthday's not all that different<n>from a normal
day, is it? I don't really<n>get why everyone makes a
fuss over<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...But, that's just my take on it. Does<n>your birthday
mean anything special<n>to you, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it does. At the very least,<n>my birthday
certainly feels different<n>from every other day.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Also... it makes me happy that you<n>and I share the
same birthday.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're happy about sharing abirthday with me? I'd get it if youwere talking about some celebrity,but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is a lot I've learned from<n>watching you.
Therefore, I feel proud<n>to share a birthday with
someone like<n>yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...C'mon, you're making me blush!<n>Let's talk about
something else!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I guess it is both our birthdays<n>today, so why
don't we go have<n>some fun?
